control_area.description: true if a short-term let control area is in force for (part of) the council area; false if not; null if not verifiable.

fee_range.description: Licence fee range as published by the council. null if the council does not publish fees in a machine-readable form.

value.description: The headline value. null means the official source has not published it — never invent a figure.

verification.description: direct-read: the official page was opened and read. search-verified: the official page was quoted verbatim via search results.

description: Validates the data files in this repository. Two shapes are accepted: rule-item files (data/wales.json, data/england.json) and the per-council file (data/scotland-councils.json). Every record must carry a source_url and a last_checked date (YYYY-MM-DD). Figures the official source does not publish are null, never invented.

last_updated.description: Date the file was last refreshed, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: UK short-term let regulations data file
